title: Opening
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-deduction/assets/images/office_interior_nophone.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, secretary, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Secretary>>
You're late. Again.
<<speaker, Detective>>
The city kept me up.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
The city doesn't pay rent. The landlord came by twice.
<<speaker, Detective>>
How much do we have?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Enough for the phone bill or the light bill. Pick one.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Keep the phone. I can work in the dark.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Good. Because the phone rang at eight. Vivian Ash.
<<speaker, Detective>>
The Vivian Ash? Hill money?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Someone stole her gem last night. The Crimson Heart. She wants us on it today.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Why us?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
She asked for someone discreet. I think she meant cheap.
I pinned up everything we have. Half of it turned up in this office last night.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Then let's see who it points at.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Briggs wants a name by tonight. Give him the right one.
<<jump, Board>>

title: VerdictRight
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-deduction/assets/images/corkboard.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<speaker, Detective>>
Vivian Ash pawned her own gem and called it a theft. The photo is her motive. The key and the ticket are her proof.
Jimmy carried the box and stayed quiet too long. Mae saw the handover.
<<character, show, commissioner, x = 680>>
<<speaker, "Commissioner Briggs">>
The insurance company is going to love you. I'm going to pretend this was my idea.

title: VerdictPartlyRight
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-deduction/assets/images/corkboard.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<speaker, Detective>>
The ticket puts the gem in a pawnshop under her name. The rest I can't explain.
<<character, show, commissioner, x = 680>>
<<speaker, "Commissioner Briggs">>
Then I'll take the lady and the lawyer both and let the judge sort it out.
<<character, hide, commissioner>>
<<character, show, secretary, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Jimmy spends a night in a cell for helping. Next time finish the board.

title: VerdictWrong
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-deduction/assets/images/corkboard.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<speaker, Detective>>
It has to be the lawyer.
<<character, show, commissioner, x = 680>>
<<speaker, "Commissioner Briggs">>
Finally someone agrees with me. We pick him up at nine.
<<character, hide, commissioner>>
<<character, show, secretary, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Mrs. Ash sent flowers. They're very expensive. I hate them.
